questions: Do your hands shake when you hold them out like that?

Do you sometimes find yourself making repetitive movements with your hands that are hard to stop?
Are you taking any medication for the shaking?

results: 1. cognitive screen (MMSE / MoCA / FAB): MMSE 23/30 and Frontal Assessment Battery 9/18 - frontal/executive dysfunction
2. copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: normal - excludes Wilson disease
3. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): NOTCH2NLC GGC repeat expansion - genetically confirmed NIID
4. skin biopsy: eosinophilic, p62- and ubiquitin-POSITIVE intranuclear inclusions in adipocytes, sweat gland cells and fibroblasts - diagnostic of NIID
